notes.title: Update 1.1 is OUT NOW! - Gameplay Improvements & Level Design Changes
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25869760/7f6785b71a4d6173a932c1602c45090638a5bbdb.jpg[/img]

Hi guys,

we are still working on improving the experience of Unknown Fate and because of that we bring you new update!

[b]Here is the full changelog:[/b]

[list]
[*] Improved menu navigation (PC only).
[*] Monitor puzzle translated into Italian.
[*] Fix for second power (move).
[*] User can now select a level to play it again. This menu appear when you select "CONTINUE" in the main menu once finished the game.
[*] Improved volume for voice over.
[*] Improved enemies animations.
[*]  Imropoved enemies collision detection.
[*] Improved level design.
[*] Updated to last version of Unity. This should solve some minor and major random bugs (like crashes and things like that)
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25869760/cfd356f7340354932e9388eee788657a777c2e8d.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25869760/50d964012c4d28dd34def3569597d6b93adf2c83.jpg[/img]

notes.title: We have a release date!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25869760/77e077786d3a342f13c8cdba46639250a2984ff3.png[/img]

Hi guys,

we know that it has been a while but we finally have a release date! It is scheduled to come out on [b]6th of September this year![/b] It will be compatible with HTC VIVE so get ready for a surreal VR adventure full of twisted and mind blowing puzzles while encountering strange creatures!
